description: Type definitions for the 'dns/promises' API in Node.js, providing asynchronous DNS methods returning Promises, including resolves, lookups, and server configuration.

classes.name: Resolver
classes.description: An independent resolver class for making DNS queries with customizable DNS server settings.

methods.name: function getServers(): string[]; getServers
methods.description: Returns the list of DNS servers currently configured for resolution.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Resolves a hostname into its IPv4 or IPv6 address, with options for specifics.

methods.name: lookupService
methods.description: Resolves an IP address and port into hostname and service name.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves DNS records for a hostname, with specific methods for each record type.

methods.name: resolve4
methods.description: Resolves IPv4 addresses (A records) for a hostname.

methods.name: resolve6
methods.description: Resolves IPv6 addresses (AAAA records) for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveAny
methods.description: Resolves any DNS record associated with a hostname.

methods.name: resolveCaa
methods.description: Resolves CAA DNS records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveCname
methods.description: Resolves CNAME records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveMx
methods.description: Resolves MX records for email routing.

methods.name: resolveNaptr
methods.description: Resolves NAPTR records for services like SIP.

methods.name: resolveNs
methods.description: Resolves NS records (name servers) for a hostname.

methods.name: resolvePtr
methods.description: Resolves PTR records for reverse DNS lookups.

methods.name: resolveSoa
methods.description: Resolves SOA records providing authoritative information.

methods.name: resolveSrv
methods.description: Resolves SRV records used for service discovery.

methods.name: resolveTlsa
methods.description: Resolves TLSA records for DANE DNSSEC.

methods.name: resolveTxt
methods.description: Resolves TXT records stored in DNS.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Performs reverse DNS lookup from IP to hostname.

methods.name: setServers
methods.description: Sets the DNS servers to be used for resolution.

methods.name: setDefaultResultOrder
methods.description: Configures the default order for address resolution results.
